purpose: Provisional photograph-grounded critical-field labels for development evaluation, not legal-compliance verdicts.

annotation.method: Viewed each original local photograph with view_image. No OCR run, OCR transcript, catalogue quantity, or arithmetic-derived quantity was used to create these labels.
annotation.priorExposureDisclosure: Earlier task context already disclosed the Amul 8901262260121/6.jpg OCR failure and its 500 mL / INR 22 values. Those readings were checked on the photograph; this sample is not a blinded independent annotation. The other selected photographs were labelled visually without consulting their OCR outputs.
annotation.selection: Purposefully selected eight photographs across six product codes, including readable declarations and cropped, blurred, rotated, or semantically ambiguous counterexamples. This is not a random or representative accuracy sample.
annotation.freezeRule: Any later correction must record the human reviewer, reason, and new dataset version; do not silently relabel to fit OCR results.

source.name: Existing local Open Food Facts India real-label development collection
source.imageIdentity: sha256 of the exact local image bytes
source.attribution: Retain the original collection's source/attribution records when redistributing photographs. This JSON neither changes their licence nor proves capture date or provenance.

statuses.readable: Value and field identity are visually supported on this photograph; provisional positive exact-match label.
statuses.not_visible: No readable declaration value for this field appears in this photograph; not a claim that the entire package lacks it.
statuses.illegible: The relevant declaration is visible but its complete value cannot be read confidently.
statuses.ambiguous_field: A number or date is readable but its identity as the requested declaration is not established on this photograph.

scoringPolicy.denominator: Only fields with status=readable and metricEligible=true belong in provisional value exact-match denominators. Report each field denominator separately; never convert excluded fields into correct negatives.
scoringPolicy.expectedValues: A convenience map containing readable labels only. Missing keys are unlabelled, never evidence of compliant or non-compliant absence. This photo manifest is not a transcript benchmark import file.
scoringPolicy.normalization: Preserve printed numeric digits and date separators. Trim outer whitespace. Quantity unit spelling/case is normalized to g, ml, or l only; do not replace OCR-confused digits, change units, infer density, derive quantity from unit price or servings, or infer a century for two-digit years.
scoringPolicy.surfaces: surface is a readable declaration excerpt, not a full transcript or a claim of exact typography/spacing. For spatially separated headings and values, heading and surface are recorded separately.
scoringPolicy.dateMeaning: packDate accepts only visibly identified packed/packing/manufactured dates. Use-by, expiry, marketing years, batch codes, and dates with cropped headings are excluded.
scoringPolicy.falseClearRateReason: No officer-adjudicated legal verdict labels are supplied.
scoringPolicy.claimsAllowed: Provisional development diagnostics only. Neither accuracy on unseen real labels nor legal correctness nor human-validated ground truth is established.
